correctness.rationale: Given fixed τ, marked endpoints are a uniform 2k-subset and unmarked matching is independent uniform. Uniform gap compositions give P(G_j=0)=m/N and exchangeable mixed-neighbor moments U+mV=r²/N. Splitting neighboring positions into marked-marked, unmarked-unmarked, and mixed yields mD(τ)/N + r²/(2N)+mr/N = N/2 +(m/N)(D(τ)−m/2), with r=0 separately treated. For two chords, three patterns occur with probability 1/3 and descent numbers 2,1,3, leading to Cov(D,C)=−(n−1)/3, Cov(D,H)=(n−1)/3, Cov(D,A)=0. Independent exact enumeration all matchings and all marked subsets for n=1..5 confirms each conditional pattern and three covariances; finite enumeration not infinite proof.
